name: High Heaven Sword Sect
desc: The High Heaven Sword Sect stands among the peaks of Jueyun, where mountain gates, sword pavilions, and testing platforms rise tier by tier under year-round astral gales. Within the sect, the paths of sword control, thunder sword, and sword nurturing stand side by side, and disciples climb the cliffs at dawn and dusk to seek insight before the sword steles. It is a place that worships sharpness and purity, prizes reputation and personal enlightenment alike, and produces both meteoric prodigies and lonely talents trapped by obsession.

name: Ten Thousand Beasts Mountain
desc: Ten Thousand Beasts Mountain lies deep within the Hundred-Thousand Mountains, where ninety-nine layered grotto-heavens confine a vast menagerie ranging from low-grade spirit beasts to murderous demon kings. Beast pens, blood-feeding grounds, and spirit-binding altars never truly fall silent. Its disciples usually follow the paths of beast driving, beast breeding, or blood refining; some treat their beasts as companions, while others see them as expendable force. The mountain atmosphere is primal and domineering, teaching disciples to subdue beasts with strength and temper their own survival instincts through the law of the wild.

name: Listening Tide Pavilion
desc: Listening Tide Pavilion stands atop the cliffs of Jinghaiya, where halls of frost spirit jade reflect moonlit tides and starlight. Its true treasures are not weapons but the Sea-Watching Jade Wall, tide observatories, and star charts used for celestial deduction. Disciples train in stargazing, listening to the tides, and divination, speaking little while learning to read change from wind, surf, and the subtlest turns of the human heart. The entire pavilion feels cold and distant, as though everyone views the world through mist, producing both detached sages and reclusive souls drawn too deeply into heavenly secrets.

name: Nine Underworlds Dao
desc: The Nine Underworld Springs Dao rules the islands of the Dead Sea, where soul-guiding halls, ferry bridges, corpse vaults, and ghost-lantern corridors stand amid year-round sea fog. To come and go here feels like walking through the seam between life and death. Its branches include soul refining, death ferrying, and yin arts, and disciples cultivate beside dead spirits, corpse puppets, and currents of underworld qi, forming a view of mortality unlike that of ordinary cultivators. The order within is severe and the atmosphere bitterly cold, fostering followers who are quiet, restrained, and frighteningly willing to treat all things as a price to be paid.

name: Thousand Mechanisms Sect
desc: Thousand Mechanisms Sect hides in the depths of Qianji Valley. From afar its terraces and halls appear intricate and elegant, yet within them lie mechanism corridors, puppet workshops, poison arsenals, and secret tunnels where every brick may conceal a killing trap. Its disciples broadly divide into mechanism masters, puppet makers, poison specialists, Gu masters, and stealth operatives. They must understand both construction and ambush, and learn to preserve themselves through insects, poison devices, and hidden passages. The Gu lineage excels at using Gu vessels to cast subtle arts, relying on Mind-Sinking, Blood-Devouring, Essence-Eroding, and Heart-Disordering Gu to influence enemies from the dark. Success lets the effect linger; failure may expose their trail. The sect prizes efficiency, secrecy, and results, so cooperation usually rests on shared benefit, making it a cradle for brilliant schemers and endlessly tense rivalries.

name: Drunken Dream Pavilion
desc: Drunken Dream Pavilion rises within a hidden heaven inside a bustling city, where incense chambers, waterside terraces, music halls, and dream pools connect beneath unending song by day and lantern glow by night. Cultivation here relies on far more than dual cultivation alone; disciples also study incense arts, music, dance, negotiation, and the reading of human moods, often blending charm arts with performance and intelligence work. The pavilion excels at turning mortal desire into cultivation fuel and reading the warmth or chill in every relationship, so its people may become dazzlingly perceptive or lose themselves in the maze between true and false affection.

name: Sumeru Zen Temple
desc: Sumeru Zen Temple stands on Pudu Island amid the Storm Sea, with the Vajra Pagoda at its heart and demon-quelling halls, bell platforms, austerity cliffs, and medicinal baths set around it. Once the bells begin to ring, the whole island seems held fast by invisible Buddhist light. Its disciples follow the paths of meditation, martial cultivation, or protector practice, studying scriptures and tempering the body while often being sent to guard the sea against fiends and receive those in distress. Though outwardly solemn and austere, the temple is not lifeless, and many monks carry a deeply worldly compassion beneath their iron resolve.

name: Shadow Fiend Hall
desc: Shadow Fiend Hall lurks deep within the Shadow Marsh, where hidden towers perch above the canopy and secret passages wind beneath the mire. Shadow cells, stealth grounds, poison miasma pools, and intelligence outposts overlap so completely that outsiders rarely grasp its true shape. Its disciples divide among assassination, escape movement, pursuit, and corpse-handling work, learning from the first day to erase tracks, hide intent, and survive desperate situations. Warmth is scarce here; everyone watches and doubts everyone else, yet that same harshness forges a kind of tacit understanding that only shows itself at the edge of death.

name: Myriad Treasures Alliance
desc: Myriad Treasures Alliance is built across the islands of Duobao in the sky, where auction halls, the Thousand-Furnace Tower, cloudship docks, grand vaults, and mercantile houses all connect into a sect that feels more like an immortal city that never closes. Its cultivators practice commerce as seriously as cultivation, dividing into forging, appraisal, shipping, accounts, and foreign trade. Many disciples learn from childhood how to price goods, bargain, draft contracts, and keep trade routes alive. The alliance prizes circulation and efficiency above all, and everyone understands how resources turn into influence, making it more practical, orderly, and reputation-conscious than most sects.

name: Soul-Seizing Sound Sect
desc: Soul-Seizing Sound Sect occupies Echo Valley, where qin towers, drum stages, testing corridors, and soul-harvesting array fields spread with the mountain slope. When valley winds rise, even the faintest string note can swell into a lethal, spirit-rending strike. The sect is divided among illusion sound, killing sound, and soul-settling branches, and its disciples study not only musical theory and techniques but also rhythm, breath, emotional guidance, and spiritual control. It appears elegant on the surface, yet the atmosphere is dangerously tense, and what is most frightening here is often not open anger, but a gentle melody falling at just the right moment.

name: Heavenly Deduction Sect
desc: Heavenly Deduction Sect stands in Mizhongtian, where a single peak conceals countless folded spaces layered with the Heaven-Deduction Platform, Ten-Thousand-Array Gallery, formation testing valley, and geomantic wells. A disciple who does not understand array maps may fail even to find the way home. Its branches include heavenly deduction, earth-vein arrays, artifact arrays, and defensive formations. Its members are adept at deducing array diagrams and can use formation disks to temporarily draw earth-vein power through spiritual lands, sect grounds, mines, herb fields, and beast domains, setting spirit-gathering, mountain-guarding, healing, clarity, and other formations. Whether laying a small formation or reshaping an entire landscape, they prize precision and order. The sect attracts minds obsessed with structure and law, and it often produces cold array masters who treat human affairs as variables to be calculated.

name: Everlasting Bright Palace
desc: Everlasting Bright Palace lies in the Aurora Heaven of the far northern eternal night, where the Hall of Lasting Light, sacred flame altars, marrow-cleansing pools, and radiant training grounds stand forever lit by the aurora. Ice and fire coexist there, giving the entire palace city an almost miraculous dignity. Its cultivators broadly follow the paths of body tempering, life protection, and longevity, valuing weapons and martial discipline alongside medicinal baths, secret arts, and insight into the source of life itself. The palace reveres light, endurance, and constancy, and its people often bear immense discipline and responsibility, even to the point of burning themselves out in silence.

name: Haoran Academy
desc: Haoran Academy stands within the Forest of Sages, where lecture halls, the Hall of Clear Law, stele libraries, and heart-questioning stone paths spread beneath the trees. Even before the morning bell, the sound of reading already rises through the woods, and the disciples who pass by tend to be neatly robed and measured in speech. Its traditions include classical study, legal reasoning, governance, and literary cultivation; scholars here do more than read and nourish qi, for they also debate policy, refine conduct, and teach future generations. The academy values integrity, reputation, and the transmission of teacherly lineage, producing both noble-minded gentlemen and stubborn figures unwilling to bend.

name: Rakshasa Blood Sect
desc: Rakshasa Blood Sect reigns over the Shura Blood Pool, where blood-river altars, merit halls, bone-refining caves, and essence-seizing platforms run day and night beneath air thick with blood mist, medicine fumes, and rust. Its internal paths broadly include blood battle, sacrificial cultivation, plunder, and body tempering, and resources are distributed directly by battle results, offerings, and personal notoriety. The strong can rise with terrifying speed, while the weak are swallowed just as quickly. It is a place devoted to the most naked order of power, where cruelty is ordinary and empty words mean less than strength proven in blood.
